title: Dabanitteh xin
intro: Atu waktit safar qemmissam faxxa, imaan kee qibaadah caylat axawah tan mistirit garayta. cubbus canka butta ken ayyuntih qaadoodi sadak, monotheism baadal polytheism xakabuh. Ken aydaadi Yalli isi meqeh tan naqoosa kaxxam qaadik tan gitittel dacrisam duudaamih sumaq kinni. Atu tama assakat le muucitte mamaxxaga baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Nanu qunxa buttak sugne qunxaaneyti inki Yallal yaamineenim, ni ummatta fidin shirkitte luk sugtem takkay immay.
Nanu ni imaanal nee meysiseh yan qanxaffe le miraacak kude, gadaamat kee rabak meysitak.
Nanu Yallih racmatta kee ni zulmih kalalu niyaatak, qilsi aracal dabboh sugne.
Ni degelti kaxxa xin fan nee kah radennah abe, wakti tatur saduh yan assakat le xin.
nanu xiinik ugte wak, nanu naamineh nanu dubuk ayro hinnay ayrok exxa rabboh, nummaak taturte fidin waktih aaxaguk masuginno.
Qur’aanak sidiica boolih sanatah ninni doolatal sugneeh, sagaal sanatak dagah sugneeh, seehadayti baxih asta tekke.

outcome.label: Xalu

outcome.answer: oson xiinih ugten adda xer asta

verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (Al-Kahf 18:25)
arabic: وَلَبِثُوا فِي كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِينَ وَازْدَادُوا تِسْعًا
